#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Differential expression analysis using PyDESeq2.

Compares KL (treatment) vs WL (control):
1. Full dataset (KL1-3 vs WL1-3)
2. Excluding third replicates (KL1-2 vs WL1-2) due to batch effects

Criteria: p < 0.05, |log2FC| > 1, baseMean > 10, with LFC shrinkage.
"""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
import os

# Load count data
counts_df = pd.read_csv("/workspace/inputs/count.csv", index_col=0)
print(f"Loaded count matrix: {counts_df.shape[0]} genes x {counts_df.shape[1]} samples")
print(f"Columns: {list(counts_df.columns)}")

# ============================================================
# Analysis 1: Full dataset (KL1-3 vs WL1-3)
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("ANALYSIS 1: Full dataset (KL1-3 vs WL1-3)")
print("="*60)

# Create metadata
samples_full = list(counts_df.columns)
condition_full = ["KL" if "KL" in s else "WL" for s in samples_full]
metadata_full = pd.DataFrame({
    "sample": samples_full,
    "condition": condition_full
})
metadata_full = metadata_full.set_index("sample")

print(f"Metadata:\n{metadata_full}")

# Create DESeq dataset
dds_full = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts_df,
    metadata=metadata_full,
    design_factors="condition",
    refit_cooks=True,
)

# Filter low-count genes (DESeq2's independent filtering)
dds_full.deseq2()

# Run statistical analysis with LFC shrinkage (apeglm)
stat_res_full = DeseqStats(
    dds_full,
    contrast=["condition", "KL", "WL"],
    alpha=0.05,
    cooks_filter=True,
    independent_filter=True,
)

# Run the Wald test and LFC shrinkage
stat_res_full.summary()
stat_res_full.SE

# LFC shrinkage using apeglm
stat_res_full.lfc_shrink(coeff="condition_KL_vs_WL", method="apeglm")

# Get results
res_full = stat_res_full.results_df
print(f"\nTotal genes in results: {len(res_full)}")

# Apply filters
sig_full = res_full[
    (res_full["padj"] < 0.05) &
    (res_full["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 1) &
    (res_full["baseMean"] > 10)
]
n_sig_full = len(sig_full)

up_full = len(sig_full[sig_full["log2FoldChange"] > 1])
down_full = len(sig_full[sig_full["log2FoldChange"] < -1])

print(f"\nSignificant DEGs (padj<0.05, |log2FC|>1, baseMean>10): {n_sig_full}")
print(f"  Upregulated in KL: {up_full}")
print(f"  Downregulated in KL: {down_full}")

# Save results
res_full.to_csv("/workspace/codex_output/full_results.csv")
sig_full.to_csv("/workspace/codex_output/full_sig_genes.csv")

# ============================================================
# Analysis 2: Excluding third replicates (KL1-2 vs WL1-2)
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("ANALYSIS 2: Excluding third replicates (KL1-2 vs WL1-2)")
print("="*60)

# Subset to exclude KL3 and WL3
samples_reduced = [s for s in counts_df.columns if s not in ["KL3", "WL3"]]
counts_reduced = counts_df[samples_reduced]

condition_reduced = ["KL" if "KL" in s else "WL" for s in samples_reduced]
metadata_reduced = pd.DataFrame({
    "sample": samples_reduced,
    "condition": condition_reduced
})
metadata_reduced = metadata_reduced.set_index("sample")

print(f"Metadata:\n{metadata_reduced}")

# Create DESeq dataset
dds_reduced = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts_reduced,
    metadata=metadata_reduced,
    design_factors="condition",
    refit_cooks=True,
)

dds_reduced.deseq2()

stat_res_reduced = DeseqStats(
    dds_reduced,
    contrast=["condition", "KL", "WL"],
    alpha=0.05,
    cooks_filter=True,
    independent_filter=True,
)

stat_res_reduced.summary()
stat_res_reduced.SE

# LFC shrinkage using apeglm
stat_res_reduced.lfc_shrink(coeff="condition_KL_vs_WL", method="apeglm")

res_reduced = stat_res_reduced.results_df
print(f"\nTotal genes in results: {len(res_reduced)}")

sig_reduced = res_reduced[
    (res_reduced["padj"] < 0.05) &
    (res_reduced["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 1) &
    (res_reduced["baseMean"] > 10)
]
n_sig_reduced = len(sig_reduced)

up_reduced = len(sig_reduced[sig_reduced["log2FoldChange"] > 1])
down_reduced = len(sig_reduced[sig_reduced["log2FoldChange"] < -1])

print(f"\nSignificant DEGs (padj<0.05, |log2FC|>1, baseMean>10): {n_sig_reduced}")
print(f"  Upregulated in KL: {up_reduced}")
print(f"  Downregulated in KL: {down_reduced}")

res_reduced.to_csv("/workspace/codex_output/reduced_results.csv")
sig_reduced.to_csv("/workspace/codex_output/reduced_sig_genes.csv")

# ============================================================
# Comparison
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("COMPARISON")
print("="*60)

change = n_sig_reduced - n_sig_full
pct_change = (change / n_sig_full * 100) if n_sig_full > 0 else 0

direction = "increase" if change > 0 else ("decrease" if change < 0 else "no change")
print(f"\nFull dataset (KL1-3 vs WL1-3): {n_sig_full} significant DEGs")
print(f"Reduced dataset (KL1-2 vs WL1-2): {n_sig_reduced} significant DEGs")
print(f"Change: {change:+d} genes ({pct_change:+.1f}%)")
print(f"Direction: {direction}")

# Check overlap
if n_sig_full > 0 and n_sig_reduced > 0:
    overlap = len(set(sig_full.index) & set(sig_reduced.index))
    only_full = len(set(sig_full.index) - set(sig_reduced.index))
    only_reduced = len(set(sig_reduced.index) - set(sig_full.index))
    print(f"\nOverlap: {overlap} genes significant in both")
    print(f"Only in full: {only_full}")
    print(f"Only in reduced: {only_reduced}")

# Write answer
with open("/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(direction)
print(f"\nAnswer written: {direction}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Differential expression analysis using PyDESeq2.

Compares KL (treatment) vs WL (control):
1. Full dataset (KL1-3 vs WL1-3)
2. Excluding third replicates (KL1-2 vs WL1-2) due to batch effects

Criteria: p < 0.05, |log2FC| > 1, baseMean > 10, with LFC shrinkage.
"""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
import os

# Load count data (genes as rows, samples as columns)
counts_df = pd.read_csv("/workspace/inputs/count.csv", index_col=0)
print(f"Loaded count matrix: {counts_df.shape[0]} genes x {counts_df.shape[1]} samples")
print(f"Columns: {list(counts_df.columns)}")

# PyDESeq2 expects samples as rows, genes as columns (AnnData format)
counts_t = counts_df.T
print(f"Transposed: {counts_t.shape[0]} samples x {counts_t.shape[1]} genes")

def run_deseq_analysis(counts_t, samples_list, label):
    """Run DESeq2 analysis on given samples."""
    # Subset to requested samples
    counts_sub = counts_t.loc[samples_list]

    # Create metadata
    condition = ["KL" if "KL" in s else "WL" for s in samples_list]
    metadata = pd.DataFrame({"condition": condition}, index=samples_list)
    metadata.index.name = "sample"

    print(f"\nSamples: {samples_list}")
    print(f"Condition: {condition}")

    # Create DESeq dataset
    dds = DeseqDataSet(
        counts=counts_sub,
        metadata=metadata,
        design_factors="condition",
        refit_cooks=True,
    )

    # Run DESeq2
    dds.deseq2()

    # Statistical testing with LFC shrinkage
    stat_res = DeseqStats(
        dds,
        contrast=["condition", "KL", "WL"],
        alpha=0.05,
        cooks_filter=True,
        independent_filter=True,
    )

    stat_res.summary()
    stat_res.SE

    # LFC shrinkage using apeglm
    stat_res.lfc_shrink(coeff="condition_KL_vs_WL", method="apeglm")

    res = stat_res.results_df
    print(f"Total genes with results: {len(res)}")

    # Apply filters: p < 0.05, |log2FC| > 1, baseMean > 10
    sig = res[
        (res["padj"] < 0.05) &
        (res["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 1) &
        (res["baseMean"] > 10)
    ]
    n_sig = len(sig)

    up = len(sig[sig["log2FoldChange"] > 1])
    down = len(sig[sig["log2FoldChange"] < -1])

    print(f"Significant DEGs (padj<0.05, |log2FC|>1, baseMean>10): {n_sig}")
    print(f"  Upregulated in KL: {up}")
    print(f"  Downregulated in KL: {down}")

    return res, sig, n_sig

# ============================================================
# Analysis 1: Full dataset (KL1-3 vs WL1-3)
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("ANALYSIS 1: Full dataset (KL1-3 vs WL1-3)")
print("="*60)

samples_full = ["KL1", "KL2", "KL3", "WL1", "WL2", "WL3"]
res_full, sig_full, n_sig_full = run_deseq_analysis(counts_t, samples_full, "full")

# ============================================================
# Analysis 2: Excluding third replicates (KL1-2 vs WL1-2)
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("ANALYSIS 2: Excluding third replicates (KL1-2 vs WL1-2)")
print("="*60)

samples_reduced = ["KL1", "KL2", "WL1", "WL2"]
res_reduced, sig_reduced, n_sig_reduced = run_deseq_analysis(counts_t, samples_reduced, "reduced")

# ============================================================
# Comparison
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("COMPARISON")
print("="*60)

change = n_sig_reduced - n_sig_full
pct_change = (change / n_sig_full * 100) if n_sig_full > 0 else 0

direction = "increase" if change > 0 else ("decrease" if change < 0 else "no change")
print(f"\nFull dataset (KL1-3 vs WL1-3): {n_sig_full} significant DEGs")
print(f"Reduced dataset (KL1-2 vs WL1-2): {n_sig_reduced} significant DEGs")
print(f"Change: {change:+d} genes ({pct_change:+.1f}%)")
print(f"Direction: {direction}")

# Check overlap
if n_sig_full > 0 and n_sig_reduced > 0:
    overlap = len(set(sig_full.index) & set(sig_reduced.index))
    only_full = len(set(sig_full.index) - set(sig_reduced.index))
    only_reduced = len(set(sig_reduced.index) - set(sig_full.index))
    print(f"\nOverlap: {overlap} genes significant in both")
    print(f"Only in full: {only_full}")
    print(f"Only in reduced: {only_reduced}")

# Save outputs
os.makedirs("/workspace/codex_output", exist_ok=True)
res_full.to_csv("/workspace/codex_output/full_results.csv")
sig_full.to_csv("/workspace/codex_output/full_sig_genes.csv")
res_reduced.to_csv("/workspace/codex_output/reduced_results.csv")
sig_reduced.to_csv("/workspace/codex_output/reduced_sig_genes.csv")

# Write answer
with open("/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(direction)
print(f"\nAnswer written: {direction}")
